_comment: static-ads-builder per-project config. Copied to <project-root>/<project-slug>/static-ads-builder/config.json on first run. Replace placeholders; never commit a real config to the agent folder. Optional: add a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json, e.g. {"image_gen": "manual", "vision": "builtin"}) to override the project's tools.json for this agent only; image_gen accepts fal, openai or manual here; it picks the provider of the text-free photo plates (scripts/render_ads.py --provider). Mode photo_edit picks its backend with the founder (scripts/photo_edit.py --backend). Modes photo_edit and winning_recipe read the photo_edit and recipe objects (passed with --config).

$schema_hint.copy_language: en | fr. Language of the on-ad copy and the Meta ad text.
$schema_hint.funnel_stages: all | tofu | mofu | bofu | tofu,mofu | tofu,bofu | mofu,bofu.
$schema_hint.num_ads: Concepts per batch (max 15). Each renders in every format it lists. A smaller batch beats clones.
$schema_hint.formats: Default formats per concept: 1:1 (feed), 4:5 (feed, most screen), 9:16 (Stories and Reels, text kept in the Meta safe band).
$schema_hint.visual_style: Empty = the plan picks a style per concept from skills/visual-styles/REGISTRY.md. A slug locks one style for the batch.
$schema_hint.render_width: 1080 (default) or 1440 (1440x1800 for 4:5, the size Meta's feed guide recommends). Same layout, sharper pixels.
$schema_hint.utm: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign of every link. utm_content is the ad name, utm_term the ad set.
$schema_hint.perf: Decision rules of scripts/perf.py (see its --help). target_cpa null = the account median CPA. min_spend null = one target CPA. These are rules, not benchmarks.
$schema_hint.default_model: Plates only: fal-ai/nano-banana-2 | openai/gpt-image-2 | fal-ai/nano-banana-pro. Confirmed again at Gate 2.
$schema_hint.default_resolution: Plates only: 1K | 2K | 4K. Main cost lever. Confirmed again at Gate 2.
$schema_hint.photo_edit: Mode photo_edit only (scripts/photo_edit.py). Backend openai (OPENAI_API_KEY): model sent to POST /v1/images/edits (default gpt-image-2); size 1024x1024 | 1536x1024 | 1024x1536 when a concept does not set one; quality low | medium | high; input_fidelity high keeps faces and textures closer to the source (set it to an empty string if the model refuses the field); price_per_image_usd is the figure the Gate 2 estimate multiplies: 0.17 is an estimate for one 1536x1024 high output of gpt-image-2, input image tokens not included, to check on OpenAI's pricing page and update here. Confirmed again at Gate 2. Backend fal (FAL_KEY and the fal CLI): fal_model is fal-ai/nano-banana-2 or fal-ai/nano-banana-pro, fal_resolution 1K | 2K | 4K, priced from render_ads.py's table; the photo is uploaded under a public URL. Backend manual needs none of these. Backend higgsfield (the Higgsfield MCP connected to the agent's harness): higgsfield_model (default gpt_image_2_5, any Higgsfield image model that takes image_references), higgsfield_resolution 1k | 2k | 4k, billed in Higgsfield credits, cost read with get_cost before the call.
$schema_hint.recipe: Mode winning_recipe only (scripts/recipe_variants.py): variants per recipe, each changing one variable (hook, subhead, visual, cta, surface) against the winner. Passed as --count.
